_comment: local pre-push gate for victauri (Rust workspace). Runs the FAST core of .github/workflows/ci.yml (Check&Lint + Test) locally at $0, no GitHub dependency: workspace clippy -D warnings, fmt --check, workspace tests. The heavier CI legs (no-default-features / release clippy, the cross-OS live-app E2E matrix) belong to a merge-time Tier-1 gate. Heavy cargo jobs are cost=8 (each saturates the 8 physical cores) so the scheduler serializes them. They carry explicit timeout_secs: gate-runner's 600 s default killed `test` on every COLD worktree (a fresh worktree compiles the whole workspace first; measured 600.2 s timeout, while a warm run takes ~2 min), which read as an unexplained gate failure that passed on retry. Run via the .githooks/pre-push hook (install: tools/install-gate.sh) or `gate-runner pipeline --spec .gate/gate.json`.
